whatIsIt.eli5: A learning plan: at first the many-helpers copy counts most, and slowly the one-answer copy takes over.
whatIsIt.simple: During training the total loss mixes the one-to-many and one-to-one heads; the one-to-many weight starts at 0.8 and falls linearly to 0.1 by the last epoch.
whatIsIt.engineer: L = w·L_o2m + (1−w)·L_o2o, w: 0.8 → 0.1 linearly over epochs (E2ELoss.decay).

whyExists.eli5: Learn easily first, then focus on the final answers.
whyExists.simple: Ultralytics: shifts training emphasis toward the head used at inference.
whyExists.engineer: Curriculum from dense to sparse supervision.

eli5: Slowly switch to the final-answer copy.
simple: Each epoch, lower the one-to-many weight a little.
